# UiProvider

Scopes colour scheme, density, radius, motion, direction, locale, translator, token overrides and component defaults for a subtree.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | foundation |
| Import | `import { UiProvider } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import UiProvider from '@your-scope/ui/components/UiProvider'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/foundation/UiProvider.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/foundation/UiProvider.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `colorMode` | `UiColorModeSetting` |  | Force a colour scheme for this subtree. Omit to follow the surrounding `color-scheme`. |
| `density` | `UiDensity` |  |  |
| `radius` | `UiRadius` |  |  |
| `motion` | `UiMotion` |  |  |
| `dir` | `UiDirection` |  | Writing direction. Defaults to the direction of `locale` when that is set. |
| `locale` | `string` |  | BCP 47 tag used for `lang` and `Intl` formatting. |
| `translator` | `UiTranslator` |  | Translator for built-in text (see `@your-scope/ui/i18n`). English is used when omitted. |
| `defaults` | `UiComponentDefaultsInput` |  | Component prop defaults for this subtree, merged over the outer ones. |
| `themeVars` | `Readonly<Record<`--vui-${string}`, string>>` |  | Custom property overrides, e.g. from `createThemeVars()` in `@your-scope/theme`. |
| `target` | `'self' \| 'document'` | `'self'` | `self` renders a layout-neutral wrapper; `document` applies everything to `<html>`. |
| `as` | `string` | `'div'` | Wrapper element when `target` is `self`. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |

| `default` |  |  |

## Attributes

The wrapper element (`target="self"`). With `target="document"` nothing is rendered and attributes are ignored.

## Accessibility

- Sets `dir` and `lang` on its wrapper (or on `<html>`), so native controls, hyphenation and assistive technology follow the locale.
- The wrapper is `display: contents`: it adds no box and no landmark.
- Overlays stay inside the provider in the DOM (native top layer), so they inherit its tokens and direction.

## Styling

- `.vui-provider`
- `data-vui-theme`, `data-vui-density`, `data-vui-radius`, `data-vui-motion`
- any `--vui-*` token through `themeVars`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/FoundationDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/FoundationDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
  <UiProvider color-mode="dark" density="comfortable" class="contents">
    <UiCard variant="outline" class="bg-vui-canvas">
      <p class="mb-2 text-vui-sm text-vui-muted">{{ t('demo.provider.inner') }}</p>
      <UiButton>{{ t('demo.save') }}</UiButton>
    </UiCard>
  </UiProvider>
  <UiProvider radius="none" :defaults="{ button: { variant: 'outline', color: 'secondary' } }">
    <UiCard>
      <p class="mb-2 text-vui-sm text-vui-muted">{{ t('demo.provider.inner') }}</p>
      <UiButton>{{ t('demo.save') }}</UiButton>
    </UiCard>
  </UiProvider>
</div>
```
